method: Independent model review of all 135 supplied roots, read in three manageable batches including every Spanish semantic sense and its grammatical/usage metadata. Original English translations of selected pinned Spanish-Wiktionary senses, not quotations or English-dictionary-provided equivalents, native-human certification, or a claim of rendered word coverage. Exact selected source row hash and zero-based sense index are bound for every approval. Adjective homographs and agreement-sensitive determiners are kept separate; necessary regional, rare, historical, technical and register restrictions are retained. Literal animal/material/plant-only verbal readings use the narrow it subset; human operators and animal patients are distinguished. Mandatory pronominal constructions, missing selected semantics, unsafe cross-paradigm mappings and unclear meanings are withheld. No AGID past/participle override is supplied; existing independently verified grammar, English inflection, subject and aspect guards remain required. No application source edits or publication.

rejected.reason: Mandatory pronominal ayudarse requires clitic handling and reciprocal-role support.
Relative quantity adjective requires number/context-sensitive determiner rendering; no faithful invariant English gloss selected for all forms.
Demonstrative this/these and invariant east are separate paradigms; source sense must be tied to child grammar before choosing one for adjective forms.
Rare spelling pointer to evanescer lacks a retained semantic definition for independent translation here.
Archaic variant pointer to enhestar has multiple possible senses; no independently retained semantic definition selected.
Mandatory pronominal hunted-animal evasive construction requires clitic handling.
Mandatory pronominal remilgarse requires clitic handling.
Mandatory pronominal abujar and a variant-only definition do not supply a safe independent predicate.
Mandatory pronominal agallarse requires clitic handling.
Only a pialar synonym pointer is retained; no selected semantic definition to translate independently.
Mandatory pronominal pitarse requires clitic handling.
Retained ancient-people definition conflates western Gaul/Saintonge with modern Santoña; withhold rather than silently validate defective geographic evidence.
Comparative quantity determiner needs count/mass and construction-aware English rendering; no invariant useful frame selected for all child forms.
